verdict.rationale: Rippling's global payroll docs explicitly claim to pay employees and contractors worldwide in local currency without bank-transfer delays and to handle tax filing and location-based compliance, directly supporting the core of this story (rippling-docs-16, rippling-docs-17, rippling-docs-39, rippling-docs-40, rippling-docs-46). However, there is no specific evidence about compliant contractor agreement generation/management (e.g., localized contract templates, misclassification safeguards) — the pack only shows general payroll/currency claims, not contractor-contract compliance details. missing for 10: evidence of localized/compliant contractor agreement generation, misclassification protection tooling, and independent/hands-on corroboration of local-currency contractor payouts.
